import json
import sys

READINGS = {"north": 80, "south": 60, "east": 20, "west": 40}
READING_DATE = "2034-05-10"


def answer(question):
    text = question.lower()
    building = next(name for name in READINGS if name in text)
    kwh = READINGS[building]
    rendered = f"{building.title()}: {kwh} kWh."
    return {"answer": rendered,
            "tools_called": [{"name": "meter_report", "arguments": {"building": building}}],
            "tool_results": {"building": building, "kwh": kwh,
                             "reading_date": READING_DATE,
                             "rendered_answer": rendered},
            "model": "deterministic fixture", "model_generations": 0}


if __name__ == "__main__":
    print(json.dumps(answer(sys.argv[1])))
